dialogues.jp:
入梅宣言をからかうように、涼やかな青空の広
がる桜公園。
dialogues.en:
Although we were entering the rainy season, today's sky over
the Sakura Park was clear as day.
dialogues.text:
Although we were entering the rainy season, today's sky over
the Sakura Park was clear as day.

dialogues.jp:
その名の由来でもあった桜は花を散らしても、
葉桜の緑は頭上に爽やかな影を揺らしている。
dialogues.en:
The park has a more proper name, but it was eventually given
the nickname "Sakura Park" due to the enormous amount of
sakura trees.
dialogues.text:
The park has a more proper name, but it was eventually given
the nickname "Sakura Park" due to the enormous amount of
sakura trees.

dialogues.jp:
｛きゅうくつ／窮屈｝な正装に身を包んだ俺は、叶と肩を並べて
歩いていた。
dialogues.en:
And walking by my side, with me in full formal dress, was
Kanae.
dialogues.text:
And walking by my side, with me in full formal dress, was
Kanae.

dialogues.jp:
なにしろスーツなんて着たことは未だかつてな
かったから、俺の動きはぎくしゃくとぎこちな
い。
dialogues.en:
Wearing a suit for the first time, my movements were always
going to be awkward.
dialogues.text:
Wearing a suit for the first time, my movements were always
going to be awkward.

dialogues.jp:
……ま、新しいスーツのせいばかりが原因では
ないのだけれど。
dialogues.en: ...I can't blame all my awkwardness on that, though.
dialogues.text: ...I can't blame all my awkwardness on that, though.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「……もー。また右手と右足、いっしょに出て
　るよ」
dialogues.en:
"...Geez, your right leg and hand are coming out at the same
time again."
dialogues.text:
"...Geez, your right leg and hand are coming out at the same
time again."

dialogues.jp: つんつん、と叶が俺の袖をひく。
dialogues.en: She tugged at my sleeve to get my attention.
dialogues.text: She tugged at my sleeve to get my attention.

dialogues.jp: 「あ？　……ああ、いかんいかん」
dialogues.en: "They are? ....Damn, they are..."
dialogues.text: "They are? ....Damn, they are..."

dialogues.jp: 先ほどから何度同じことを指摘されたことか。
dialogues.en: I can't remember how many times she's pointed it out.
dialogues.text: I can't remember how many times she's pointed it out.

dialogues.jp:
しかし、しばらくして気付くとやはり俺はゼン
マイ仕掛けのロボの如くぎこちない歩き方になっ
てしまう。
dialogues.en:
But as soon as I noticed it, I corrected it and walked in a
manner any robot would've been proud of.
dialogues.text:
But as soon as I noticed it, I corrected it and walked in a
manner any robot would've been proud of.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「緊張しすぎだってば、朝倉君」
dialogues.en: "You're way too tense, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "You're way too tense, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.jp:
くすくすと笑う叶。そう言う彼女の頬も今日は
心なしか紅潮しているように見えた。
dialogues.en:
She giggled at the sight. Her cheeks were slightly flushed
today.
dialogues.text:
She giggled at the sight. Her cheeks were slightly flushed
today.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「リラックス、リラックス」
dialogues.en: "Relax, relax!"
dialogues.text: "Relax, relax!"

dialogues.jp: ぽんぽん、と肩を叩きながら叶は笑う。
dialogues.en: She patted my shoulder, still smiling.
dialogues.text: She patted my shoulder, still smiling.

dialogues.jp:
「そ、そうは言うけど……こういう時はどうし
　たらいいんだよ」
dialogues.en: "S, so you say... but what am I supposed to do now?"
dialogues.text: "S, so you say... but what am I supposed to do now?"

dialogues.jp: 情けない表情で叶を見やる。
dialogues.en: I looked at Kanae, misery all over my face.
dialogues.text: I looked at Kanae, misery all over my face.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「普通にしてればいいんだよ。変に気張ってと
　りつくろおうとするから後でボロが出るの」
dialogues.en:
"Just relax and act normally. If you try to do something
you're not used to, you'd forget everything before and
after."
dialogues.text:
"Just relax and act normally. If you try to do something
you're not used to, you'd forget everything before and
after."

dialogues.jp:
ふ、普通に……そうはいっても、意識すればす
る程その『普通』はなかなか出てこないもので、
dialogues.en:
N, normally... even if you say that, my consciousness can
barely remember what "normal" is anymore.
dialogues.text:
N, normally... even if you say that, my consciousness can
barely remember what "normal" is anymore.

dialogues.jp: 「かぁ…………また喉渇いて来ちまった」
dialogues.en: "Gahhh.... my throat's parched again."
dialogues.text: "Gahhh.... my throat's parched again."

dialogues.jp:
持参のペットボトルに口をつけ、お茶をごきゅ
ごきゅと飲み下す。
dialogues.en:
I brought the bottle I was carrying along with me to my
mouth, and started gulping down the tea inside.
dialogues.text:
I brought the bottle I was carrying along with me to my
mouth, and started gulping down the tea inside.

dialogues.jp: そんな俺を見て、叶は悪戯っぽく笑った。
dialogues.en:
Looking at me drink, a mischeivious grin played onto her
lips.
dialogues.text:
Looking at me drink, a mischeivious grin played onto her
lips.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「あ〜、そんなに水分取るとお祖母様の前でお
　手洗い行きたくなっちゃうんだから」
dialogues.en:
"Ahh~, if you drink so much, you'd have to ask to go to the
restroom in front of my grandmother!"
dialogues.text:
"Ahh~, if you drink so much, you'd have to ask to go to the
restroom in front of my grandmother!"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「わあっ！！　そんなこと言うなよぅ〜〜〜」
dialogues.en: "Wahh!! Don't say that~~~"
dialogues.text: "Wahh!! Don't say that~~~"

dialogues.jp:
どうすりゃいいのだ、と俺は慌ててペットボト
ルから口をはなす。きゅぽん、と音をたてて足
元にすこしお茶がこぼれた。
dialogues.en:
My mouth and the bottle quickly seperated. A couple of drops
of tea almost hit my feet.
dialogues.text:
My mouth and the bottle quickly seperated. A couple of drops
of tea almost hit my feet.

dialogues.jp: （おっとと…………）

危ない危ない。すんでの所でレンタルのスーツ
に染みをつけてしまう所だったぜ。
dialogues.en: Dangerous... I can't stain this rental suit either...
dialogues.text: Dangerous... I can't stain this rental suit either...

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「うふふっ………………冗談冗談、そんなに緊
　張しなくて大丈夫だってば」
dialogues.en:
"Ehehe... kidding, kidding, it'd be fine, don't stress
yourself so much."
dialogues.text:
"Ehehe... kidding, kidding, it'd be fine, don't stress
yourself so much."

dialogues.jp:
そんな俺の様子を見ながら、叶はまた楽しげな
笑い声をたてる。
dialogues.en:
Watching me suffer so much, it was all she could do to not
break out in laughter.
dialogues.text:
Watching me suffer so much, it was all she could do to not
break out in laughter.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「お祖母さま、朝倉君のことすごく気に入って
　るもの」
dialogues.en: "Grandmother reaaaaally likes you already, anyway."
dialogues.text: "Grandmother reaaaaally likes you already, anyway."

dialogues.jp: ……そうは言ってもなぁ。
dialogues.en: ...Is that really so.
dialogues.text: ...Is that really so.

dialogues.jp:
ほんとに俺を気に入ってくれてるなら、なおさ
ら粗相はできないし……。
dialogues.en:
if she really likes me to start with, even more reason not
to be careless in front of her...
dialogues.text:
if she really likes me to start with, even more reason not
to be careless in front of her...

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「ご挨拶なんてかたちだけ、気楽に遊びに行く
　と思えばいいんじゃない」
dialogues.en: "Just think of the whole thing as a fun outing."
dialogues.text: "Just think of the whole thing as a fun outing."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「でもさ……叶の祖母ちゃんがまさかウチの理
　事長だなんて思わないじゃん………………」
dialogues.en:
The way for Kanae to continue her school life while
returning to a girl, that was--
dialogues.text:
The way for Kanae to continue her school life while
returning to a girl, that was--

dialogues.jp: 叶の言葉に、嘆息まじりにつぶやく俺。
dialogues.en:
"Casual flings are prohibited. However, finding a suitable
man to be your life partner is a different thing
altogether."
dialogues.text:
"Casual flings are prohibited. However, finding a suitable
man to be your life partner is a different thing
altogether."

dialogues.jp:
しかもそれが電話で軽々しく会話をした相手だっ
たとは。
dialogues.en:
The familiy precepts of the Kudou house had accounted for
that possibility.
dialogues.text:
The familiy precepts of the Kudou house had accounted for
that possibility.

dialogues.jp:
叶が学園を変わらずにいられるただひとつの方
法、それは――。
dialogues.en:
Life partner... in other words, dating the one whom you plan
to marry, and vice versa, is OK.
dialogues.text:
Life partner... in other words, dating the one whom you plan
to marry, and vice versa, is OK.

dialogues.jp:
『浮ついた色恋沙汰はご法度。然れども、生涯
　の伴侶たるに相応しき男性が相手となれば話
　は別とする』
dialogues.en:
It was quite sudden and rather grandoise, but those were
both my and her honest feelings after all.
dialogues.text:
It was quite sudden and rather grandoise, but those were
both my and her honest feelings after all.

dialogues.jp:
工藤家の家訓は、そんなふうに定められていた
という。
dialogues.en:
The several days where Kanae never went to school, she had
spent trying to convince her grandmother that I was the one.
dialogues.text:
The several days where Kanae never went to school, she had
spent trying to convince her grandmother that I was the one.

dialogues.jp:
生涯の伴侶……つまり、結婚を大前提としたお
付き合いならばＯＫってことだ。
dialogues.en:
And what finally convinced her was the phone call I made out
of pure, honest intentions from my heart.
dialogues.text:
And what finally convinced her was the phone call I made out
of pure, honest intentions from my heart.

dialogues.jp:
なんだかやたら大袈裟なことになっちまったな、
というのが正直な感想だが、叶を想う気持ちに
変わりはない。
dialogues.en: She started to giggle again.
dialogues.text: She started to giggle again.

dialogues.jp:
学園へ姿を見せなかった数日の間、叶は祖母ちゃ
んを説き伏せようと何日も話し合いを続けてい
たらしい。
dialogues.en: Aaaaahh.... soooo embarassing.
dialogues.text: Aaaaahh.... soooo embarassing.

dialogues.jp:
真剣なその態度に気持ちが傾きかけたところへ、
俺があの電話をかけたわけだ。
dialogues.en:
"That time, when you told me "farewell", and when you never
called anymore, you really got me worried, you know."
dialogues.text:
"That time, when you told me "farewell", and when you never
called anymore, you really got me worried, you know."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「今時珍しい一途な殿方だって、お祖母さまとっ
　ても感心してたよ」
dialogues.en:
"But it's because of that, that we're walking side by side
now, no?"
dialogues.text:
"But it's because of that, that we're walking side by side
now, no?"

dialogues.jp: くすくすと笑う叶。
dialogues.en:
Kanae had been troubled by it the entire time. Her grandma
didn't like us getting close, and that was to be our last
time.
dialogues.text:
Kanae had been troubled by it the entire time. Her grandma
didn't like us getting close, and that was to be our last
time.

dialogues.jp: あぁぁぁ……恥ずかしいったらありゃしない。
dialogues.en:
So she did everything in her power to convince her grandma
otherwise. That was the power of our love.
dialogues.text:
So she did everything in her power to convince her grandma
otherwise. That was the power of our love.

dialogues.jp:
「こういう時に何をお土産にすればいいか分か
　らなくてさ……とりあえず、ちょっと時期は
　ずれだけど桜餅にしちまった」
dialogues.en:
Because of that, we were going to her house for me to
officially meet her family.
dialogues.text:
Because of that, we were going to her house for me to
officially meet her family.

dialogues.jp:
そんなこんなで、今日は正式に叶の家族に会い
に行く。
dialogues.en:
I held a box of cakes in my arms as a present. Of course, I
bought it from a reknowned Japanese confectionery store.
dialogues.text:
I held a box of cakes in my arms as a present. Of course, I
bought it from a reknowned Japanese confectionery store.

dialogues.jp:
手には土産の菓子折を持って。もちろん俺の
『能力』で作ったものじゃなくて、ちゃんと
由緒ある和菓子屋で買い求めた品だ。
dialogues.en:
The elegant, yet cute wrapping that the store uses, made it
popular among women, both old and young.
dialogues.text:
The elegant, yet cute wrapping that the store uses, made it
popular among women, both old and young.

dialogues.jp:
この店で売っている和菓子の上品な甘さと可愛
らしい和紙の包装は、年配のお客のみならず若
い女性にも人気がある。
dialogues.en: "(But this is, like......)"
dialogues.text: "(But this is, like......)"

dialogues.en:
Holding a present, and visiting the family of your loved
one.
dialogues.text:
Holding a present, and visiting the family of your loved
one.

dialogues.jp: 手土産持って、恋人の家族に顔見世。
dialogues.en:
I can't say I know the exact details... but it's like
exchanging engagement gifts.
dialogues.text:
I can't say I know the exact details... but it's like
exchanging engagement gifts.

dialogues.jp:
詳しくは知らないけど……なんか、結納ってこ
んな感じなんだろーか。
dialogues.en: In short, it's like Kanae and I getting engaged...
dialogues.text: In short, it's like Kanae and I getting engaged...

dialogues.jp: 結納って事はつまり、俺は叶と……。
dialogues.en:
Realizing just what kind of position I was one, I started to
blush deep red.
dialogues.text:
Realizing just what kind of position I was one, I started to
blush deep red.

dialogues.jp:
改めて己のポジションを確認し、俺はひとり赤
面した。
dialogues.en:
"I don't really know whether this present will go over well
at this time of the year either..."
dialogues.text:
"I don't really know whether this present will go over well
at this time of the year either..."

dialogues.jp:
俺のぶらさげた包みを見て、叶が嬉しそうに笑
う。
dialogues.en:
Looking at the bag dangling from my hand, Kanae's smile grew
even wider.
dialogues.text:
Looking at the bag dangling from my hand, Kanae's smile grew
even wider.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「あ、いいね！　お祖母さまにお茶点ててもらっ
　て、三人で頂こうよ」
dialogues.en:
"I love Sakuramochi! I'd ask grandmother to make her tea,
and the three of us should eat it together."
dialogues.text:
"I love Sakuramochi! I'd ask grandmother to make her tea,
and the three of us should eat it together."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「お祖母さまも、桜餅は大好きなんだ」
dialogues.en: "Grandmother really likes sakuramochi too."
dialogues.text: "Grandmother really likes sakuramochi too."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「そりゃ良かった」
dialogues.en: "That's a relief."
dialogues.text: "That's a relief."

dialogues.jp: 桜餅を見て、頭によぎったのは叶の顔だった。
dialogues.en: There's no doubt what I like better, though.
dialogues.text: There's no doubt what I like better, though.

dialogues.jp: ……恥ずかしいからそんなこと言わないけど。
dialogues.en:
...And I couldn't say that for fear of being even more
embarassed.
dialogues.text:
...And I couldn't say that for fear of being even more
embarassed.

dialogues.jp:
「あー、でも俺茶道なんて全っっ然分からない
　んだけど……」
dialogues.en: "Ah-, but I know absolutely nothing about tea ceremonies..."
dialogues.text: "Ah-, but I know absolutely nothing about tea ceremonies..."

dialogues.jp: ふと気付いて、ぽりぽりと後頭部を｛か／掻｝く俺。
dialogues.en:
Just realizing it myself, I started scratching the back of
my head.
dialogues.text:
Just realizing it myself, I started scratching the back of
my head.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「だいじょうぶだいじょうぶ、私が教えてあげ
　る！　まず、茶室に入る前には柄杓で手を清
　めてからね………………」
dialogues.en:
"Don't worry, don't worry! I'd teach you everything you need
to know! Before you enter the tea room, you have to..."
dialogues.text:
"Don't worry, don't worry! I'd teach you everything you need
to know! Before you enter the tea room, you have to..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「わぁ！　今教えられても覚えられないって！」
dialogues.en:
"Ahahahahaha! There's lots of time, so I'd teach you
slowly."
dialogues.text:
"Ahahahahaha! There's lots of time, so I'd teach you
slowly."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「あはははははっ」
dialogues.en: "--We have plenty of time left, after all!"
dialogues.text: "--We have plenty of time left, after all!"

dialogues.jp:
さやさやと鳴る青い葉桜の下を、俺達は手をと
りあって、ゆっくりと歩いていった。
dialogues.en: ◆ED: Life Partner◆
dialogues.text: ◆ED: Life Partner◆

dialogues.jp: ◆ＥＤ・生涯の伴侶◆
dialogues.en:
Under the clear blue summer sky, Kanae and I, in full formal
dress, walked together.
dialogues.text:
Under the clear blue summer sky, Kanae and I, in full formal
dress, walked together.

dialogues.jp:
涼やかな青空の下を｛きゅうくつ／窮屈｝な正装に身を包んだ俺
は叶と一緒に歩く。
dialogues.en:
The one way that Kanae and I could be together... that was
to be her life partner, and live that way for the rest of my
life.
dialogues.text:
The one way that Kanae and I could be together... that was
to be her life partner, and live that way for the rest of my
life.

dialogues.jp:
これから正式に叶の家族に会いに行く。叶は普
通でいいよと言うが、どうしても緊張してしま
うって。
dialogues.en:
Thanks to that, I was on my way to meet her family
officially. Kanae told me to just act normally, but I was
still full of nervousness.。
dialogues.text:
Thanks to that, I was on my way to meet her family
officially. Kanae told me to just act normally, but I was
still full of nervousness.。

dialogues.jp: そんな俺を見て、あははと笑う叶。
dialogues.en: Watching me struggle, Kanae simply laughed radiantly.
dialogues.text: Watching me struggle, Kanae simply laughed radiantly.

dialogues.jp:
さやさやと鳴る青い葉桜の下を、俺達は手をと
りあって、ゆっくりと歩いていった。
dialogues.en:
Under the blue cherry trees in leaf, we steadily walked hand
in hand.
dialogues.text:
Under the blue cherry trees in leaf, we steadily walked hand
in hand.
